page.overview:
What is Fredbear?

Fredbear is a spring lock suit created and primarily worn by Henry Emily. He was used in Fredbear's Family Diner alongside Spring Bonnie until the restaurant's closure. Fredbear would later be used by William Afton to lure and kill Michael Brooks, who possessed the animatronic.

Fredbear is a yellowish-brown bear nearly identical to Freddy Fazbear, just with yellow fur. When possessed by Michael he seems to be empty, as his jaw hangs open and his eyes are empty except for two tiny glints of light deep within the recesses of its eye sockets. In The Twisted Ones, however, Fredbear is said to have lifeless, shining plastic eyes.

Fredbear was the titular mascot of Fredbear's Family Diner, a small diner in New Harmony, Utah owned by Henry Emily and William Afton. The costumes at the diner were designed to both be worn by others and be used as working animatronics, with mechanisms called spring locks holding back all of the animatronic parts. Henry typically wore the Fredbear costume, dancing and miming along with songs for guests and his own children. On Halloween of 1983, however, one of his children would be kidnapped and killed, leading to the diner's closure.

Two years later, William Afton would lure five children away from Freddy Fazbear's Pizza's dining room and into a small storage room, killing them and stuffing their bodies into the animatronics. One night, he put on the Fredbear suit as the animatronics began to malfunction and approached the table by the stage. William was seen by John and the two briefly made eye contact before John's attention was brought back to the stage when the animatronics onstage stopped moving. William then quickly grabbed a child named Michael Brooks and lured him away, killing him and stuffing him in the Fredbear suit. Michael's disappearance haunts his friends and they all began moving away from Utah, with only Carlton Burke staying in Hurricane. Freddy's also closed down shortly after, with none of the children being found.
